'''''Carex paniculata''''', the '''greater tussock-sedge''',<ref name=BSBI07>{{BSBI 2007|accessdate=2014-10-17 }}</ref> is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the sedge family, [[Cyperaceae]]. It grows {{convert|1.5|m}} high and can be found in most of [[Europe]] (including Britain), Northwest [[Asia]] and [[North America]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.pfaf.org/user/Plant.aspx?LatinName=Carex+paniculata|title=''Carex paniculata'' |publisher=[[Plants for a Future|PFAF]]|accessdate=May 13, 2013}}</ref>
